name: Haneda Touka
source:
"I want to move someone's heart with the story I made!"

Position: Scenario

Despite his selfishness and arbitrary, Touka is a guy who attracts people with his cheerfulness. He came to Tokyo to fulfill his dream of becoming a screenwriter. Hates showing weakness to others, so he rarely throws complains.
